topic: Gig Worker Protection Minimum Wage and Social Security Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 21, Article 23, Article 43, Seventh Schedule List III Item 22, Item 23

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 21, Article 23, Article 43, List III Item 22 (Labour), Item 23 (Social Security)

findings.limitations: Right to life includes right to livelihood and living wage under Olga Tellis v. BMC (1985) 3 SCC 545.

gaps: Code on Social Security 2020 lacks mandatory transaction-based funding levies and living wage guarantees for gig workers.
Manual scavenging persists despite statutory bans due to lack of 100% mechanized alternatives.
